header.title: Certified gemstones,
header.lead: Every gem, Rudraksha and Yantra is recommended only after reading your Kundali. Pick an item, send an enquiry, and we'll advise on suitability, weight and price on WhatsApp.

note.title: Wear a gemstone only as your Kundali advises — consult first
note.body: The wrong gem can do more harm than good. The Jyotish reads your ascendant, dasha and planetary strength to recommend the right stone, weight and wearing method.

empty.title: Nothing in this category yet
empty.body: New items are on their way. Meanwhile, browse everything or tell us what you need on WhatsApp.

detail.suitableNote: The final call is always made after reading your Kundali.
detail.certifiedBody: Every gemstone comes with a certificate from a recognised gemological lab, covering weight, colour, origin and any treatment.
detail.uncertifiedBody: Prepared the traditional way and ritually energised, with a guarantee on the purity of metal and materials.
detail.priceNote: The final price depends on weight, quality and availability. No online payment here — advice first, then you decide.
detail.how1Body: Share your name and WhatsApp number — and your concern, if you like.
detail.how2Body: The Jyotish reviews your Kundali for suitability and the right weight.
detail.how3Body: You receive the price, an auspicious muhurta and how to wear it, on WhatsApp.
